svg.text: PROCESS FLOW — layer 5: a vehicle proves a VIN predicate without the VIN (ZK-VIN) and a bounded agent (the Steward) operates the identity
PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATIONS AS THEY FELL (Plan 1, written before any run):
PASS Z-E3 admit (on-chain Groth16 verification in the gate) < 350,000 gas
PASS Z-E5 undefended single-verifier attack recovers the exact value in <= 5 queries on every seed
FAIL Z-E6 Steward keeps adversary leakage <= 3.0 bits AND serves >= 90% of honest requests, on every seed of both variants
THE STEWARD — a language model proposes, a deterministic kernel disposes; leakage is audited against a bit budget per verifier set
NARROWING ATTACK, seeds 1–30 (Sim): adversary bits (mean / max) and honest service (mean) per defence × variant
defence single bits sybil bits service single service sybil
Z-E6 parts: leakage bound held on all 60 runs = True; seeds below 90 % service = 25; minimum service = 0.7
UNCLASSIFIED // OPEN SOURCE (MIT) // RESEARCH TESTBED // NOT FOR PRODUCTION USE
DWG-007 ZK-VIN GATE AND THE STEWARD — LAYER 5
B 2026-10-31 DWG-007 added; test paths; Layer 5 o AAR-39
1. Every number is read from 5_zkp-agent-identity/results/{gas_zk,zkvin_bench,attacks}.json at build time; register rows #56 to #62 (status V) are
2. The Groth16 keys come from an INSECURE single-party setup and zkid is not constant time: research code, not a deployable system (layer 5 README).
3. Proving time has N = 10 and is descriptive only (latency charter, WM-2 B3); the verify time (N = 30) conforms; both are one host.
4. Z-E6 FAIL is reported as it fell: the Steward holds leakage under budget on every run but serves under 90 % of honest requests on 25 of 60; a
global budget alone bounds leakage as well (register #61).
5. The insider variant (amendment A2) is post hoc and enters neither Z-E5 nor Z-E6; the learner was not retrained on it.
